dataset_metadata.title: Synthetic Mississippi CMV Evidence-Issue Scenarios
dataset_metadata.publisher: Jones Law P.A. / Jones Law Group
dataset_metadata.warning: Every scenario is invented for education and schema testing. No scenario represents a client, case, collision, defendant, result, firm statistic, or allegation.

illustrative_questions: Was following distance, speed, or cruise-control status available from any vehicle or telematics system?
Did any ADAS issue a warning or apply braking, and what vehicle configuration or calibration records exist?
What communications reached the driver before impact?

potential_evidence_sources_to_investigat: vehicle gateway and GPS trip data
route assignment and delivery application records
vehicle camera clips and nearby surveillance
illustrative_questions: Which application assigned or changed the route and delivery stop?
What timestamps, device identifiers, edits, and location accuracy accompany the data?
Do original video files include pre-event and post-event context and metadata?
